reason: Adds a new helper method and refactors a few views to use it with equivalent behavior (mutating shared shape state), but it directly touches core RazorPage display logic used across the CMS, so subtle regressions in shape morphing for these specific views are possible though low-likelihood given the straightforward mechanical change.
